media.title: Madame wünscht keine Kinder (1933) — Austrian poster by Anton Ziegler
media.description: Austrian poster for Madame wünscht keine Kinder (1933), directed by Hans Steinhoff; a European-period film with music by Bronisław Kaper (Film F017). The poster is documented by Filmposter-Archiv as an Austrian 1933 poster designed by Anton Ziegler.
